_comment: The 100% checklist the agent works through. Edit freely: add, remove or reorder entries. 'hint' is a nudge, not a script; the agent plans the route itself. Check the 'completionist' entries against the Steam achievement list for your version and adjust.

objectives.title: Learn the controls
objectives.hint: Open the in-game config/controls screen and note in your notes which controller button confirms, cancels, opens the menu, opens the map and toggles auto-battle.

objectives.title: Start a new game and form a party of four
objectives.hint: A balanced party such as Warrior, Thief, White Mage, Black Mage, or anything you can justify. Write the party and the reasoning in your notes.

objectives.title: Rescue Princess Sarah from Garland
objectives.hint: Chaos Shrine north-west of Cornelia. Report back to the King: the bridge gets built and you receive the Lute.

objectives.title: Defeat Bikke's pirates in Pravoka and get the ship
Get the Crown from the Marsh Cave
Defeat Astos at the Western Keep and get the Crystal Eye
Trade the Crystal Eye to Matoya for the Jolt Tonic
Wake the Elf Prince and get the Mystic Key
Get the Nitro Powder from Cornelia Castle and have Nerrick open the canal
Defeat the Vampire in the Earth Cave and get the Star Ruby
Give the Star Ruby to the Titan and get the Earth Rod from Sarda
Defeat Lich and light the Earth Crystal
Get the Canoe from the sages in Crescent Lake
Defeat Marilith in Gurgu Volcano and light the Fire Crystal
Get the Levistone from the Ice Cavern and raise the airship
Get the Rat's Tail from the Citadel of Trials and have Bahamut upgrade the party's classes
Buy the fairy from the caravan and get the Oxyale in Gaia
Defeat Kraken in the Sunken Shrine and light the Water Crystal
objectives.hint: Pick up the Rosetta Stone in the Sunken Shrine too.

objectives.title: Learn Lufenian from Dr. Unne and get the Chime in Lufenia
Get the Warp Cube from the robot in the Waterfall Cavern
Defeat Tiamat in the Flying Fortress and light the Wind Crystal
Return to the past through the Chaos Shrine and defeat Chaos
objectives.hint: Before the final fight, do the completionist objectives that can't be done afterwards. Save in a separate slot first.

objectives.title: Get the Adamantite and have Smyth forge Excalibur
Find and defeat Warmech in the Flying Fortress
Open every treasure chest in every dungeon
objectives.hint: Use the map screen and your notes to track which areas are fully looted.

objectives.title: Complete the Bestiary (every monster entry filled)
objectives.hint: Keep a list in your notes of areas still missing entries. Some monsters are rare encounters.

objectives.title: Learn every spell your party can learn
Unlock every remaining achievement
objectives.hint: The user will list any missing achievements in the extra notes, if they want you to chase them.
